title: Artist or craftsman, and cigar-making musicians
summary: Garland says he feels like an artist, and that New Orleans musicians who rolled cigars by day also felt like artists; he has no favorite moment.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: I have got an interesting question for you, it has to do with music, but it has to do with other things. When you were younger, a few weeks ago. When you were playing your music, let's say how I can say this. Did you feel like a -- like a craftsman, like a good craftsman, when you were doing your music, or did you feel like an artist, or did you feel like both, how did you feel?
Fine, that's in -- important to know.

Do you think that a lot of the older New Orleans musicians who were -- when they weren't even full time in music, for example, when they had oh, the barbershop or making cigars, or whatever they were doing days, when they played at night did they feel like artists, too, do you think?
Well, you mean like most of the boys work in the day?
We had quite a few musicians made cigars, rolled cigars --
Take, well Barney -- well Barney's Daddy, Barney didn't do, he set up there and look at him. He didn't -- had a lot of fellows made cigars, you understand?
And work at night, play down at the Storyville District street, or New Orleans jazz, some of them be so tired they said that they sleep in the (unintelligible), you understand?
Cause they had to get up in the morning to go to roll cigars --
But they did feel like artists when they played?

Uh-huh. Because some of the sociologists have -- have not made that very clear and they felt that that happened later and I wasn't sure that that was true. I'm glad to hear that. Let me ask you, what are some of the favorite moments that you can remember now, this morning, in playing music in your lifetime, some of your -- moments that you -- could never forget?
Well one of the moments, well I'll tell you -- I don't know, all of them was all right with me. I can't say.
I got no favorite, all of them's my favorite.
